newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close down, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close down, seen rising.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished lower on Thursday as banks rushed to liquidate their excess funds on the final day of the current reserve period, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate closed at 6.173 percent against Wednesday's 6.346 close, with 30-day commercial paper falling to 6.10-6.15 against 6.30-6.35.
The market is closed for holidays on Friday and Saturday and reopens on Monday.
Dealers said banking system's liquidity would be tightening next week on income tax payments.
The bond market was inactive as traders lacked interest amid the absence of significant market-moving factors.
Consolidation was likely to continue next week.
